method: Directly inspected the original 1961 print page images 29*, 30*, 39*, 40*, 41*, 55*, 56*, 64*, 65* and 66* in the source PDF; observed printed opening/closing headings, page continuation, Latin clause placement and repeat markers.

Cross-referenced the seven unmodified locally stored GregoBase GABC source strings, exact selection IDs and source folio spans. Note-bearing source groups and original-string fingerprints come from the repository source-token procedure, not visually counted printed notes.

Structural visual comparison does not certify each pitch, neume, episema/mora, accidentals, text underlay, engraving accuracy, printed repeat rule or human editorial approval. No new score or video/audio programme is approved.

scoreSurveys.title: Kyrie XVII
visuallyObserved: The ordinary Kyrie XVII is printed in full beneath the XVII heading at the bottom of p.55*.
The source preserves Kyrie iij., Christe iij., Kyrie ij., and a distinctive final Kyrie with marked starred divisions; its terminal phrase must not be collapsed into a first-phrase repeat.
The italic 'Vel, ubi moris est' Kyrie on p.56* is a different optional printed variant; it is not the source selected by GREGOBASE-272.
holds: Do not assign the printed 56* alternative to GREGOBASE-272 or infer its use from Advent/Lent.

scoreSurveys.title: Gloria VIII · De Angelis
visuallyObserved: Gloria VIII begins on p.29*, following the end of Kyrie VIII.
The clause Qui tollis peccata mundi begins toward the foot of p.29* and continues onto p.30*.
The conclusion Cum Sancto Spiritu ... Amen appears on p.30* before the distinct Sanctus VIII heading.

scoreSurveys.title: Gloria XI · Orbis factor
visuallyObserved: Gloria XI begins after Kyrie XI at p.39*; opening 'Gloria in excelsis Deo' is present.
The Qui tollis peccata mundi clause begins at the bottom of p.39* and continues across the 39* to 40* page boundary.
The Gloria concludes with Amen on p.40*, preceding a separately headed Sanctus XI.

scoreSurveys.title: Credo III
visuallyObserved: Credo III starts beneath the terminal lines of Credo II on p.64*; the first heading at the top of that page alone is not Credo III.
The source follows Credo in unum Deum through the Incarnatus, Crucifixus and Et resurrexit clauses across pages 64*–65*.
The creed concludes at the Amen on p.66*; neither preceding Credo II text nor the next heading belongs to this score.
holds: Credo III is a distinct independent CREDO_03 selection, never inherited automatically from Mass I, VIII, XI or XVII.

scoreSurveys.title: Sanctus XI · Benedictus
visuallyObserved: Sanctus XI begins on p.40* directly after the Gloria XI Amen.
The first Hosanna appears on p.40*, followed by 'Benedictus qui' at the bottom of the page.
The continuation 'venit in nomine Domini' and final Hosanna appear at the top of p.41*; both parts remain a single canonical score/card.

scoreSurveys.title: Sanctus XVII · Benedictus
visuallyObserved: The Sanctus XVII begins on p.56* below the separately titled alternative Kyrie introduced with 'Vel, ubi moris est'.
All three Sanctus acclamations, Pleni sunt caeli, initial Hosanna, Benedictus qui venit and closing Hosanna fit on p.56*.
Do not misidentify the alternative Kyrie above the Sanctus as the Sanctus score; no canonical split into extra cards is warranted.

scoreSurveys.title: Agnus Dei XI
visuallyObserved: Agnus Dei XI begins on p.41* below the concluding Hosanna of Sanctus XI.
Three distinct musical Agnus invocations are present, the first two ending 'miserere nobis' and the third ending 'dona nobis pacem'.
The printed Ite missa est / Deo gratias beneath Agnus XI are a separate dismissal score and must not be captured as the Agnus conclusion.
holds: Do not substitute this ordinary Agnus text into a Requiem Mass or infer it was sung at a local community.

remainingCriticalGates: Map every original printed 1961 note head to staff pitch using the printed clef and compare each GABC pitch; do not infer from a rendered digital version.
Compare all neume shapes and joins, mora/episema, accidentals, divisions, custodes, repeat symbols and syllable underlay at the printed-system level.
Record every discrepancy by score ID, folio, printed system and source-neume reference. Require independent musical-editor adjudication per score before any certification.
Keep all 20 source GABCs marked provisional. No local Schola programme, Requiem variant, or calendar-based choice may be inferred.
